Item No: 359
File No : M1/34022(31)/202/2023-Proc-Sec
Dept. : MARKETING DEPARTMENT (Procurement Wing)
Sub : Procurement of Cow Ghee with Agmark Special Grade through tankers /tins from National wide dairies/ AP / 1500 kms range– Proposals for revision of tender conditions and specifications – Recommendations of the Purchase Committee placed before the TTD Board for taking a decision – Regarding.
1) Back Ground 1. Cow Ghee is the main commodity in preparation of Laddu prasadams. TTD is procuring Ghee for making laddus nearly 5000 Tonnes per year. e-Tenders are being invited through e- procurement platform of AP for procurement of quality ghee once in 6 months period at the ratio of 9:2; from National and AP State Dairies at 20,00,000 kgs and 5,00,000 kgs respectively. In addition to this, to get good flavored ghee from the dairies within1500 kms range from Tirumala, for a quantity of 10,00,000 kgs for 4 months period tenders are being invited.

2. At present Tenders are being invited for procurement of cow ghee with the following conditions under eligibility criteria.

text:
2) Proposals 3. As the prequalification values under eligibility criteria
in the tender conditions are megre, most of the small dairy
units having requisite tender conditions are participating in
tenders and offering very competitive prices. In this
regard, the Hon’ble TTD Board Members have suggested
that in order to ensure good quality of cow ghee is procured
by TTD without any adulteration, it is necessary for revision
of existing tender conditions to enable the bidders having
experienced and well established dairies to participate in
tenders.

4. Accordingly the learned Executive Officer has
reviewed with ghee Committee members along with Dairy
experts on the proposed tender conditions / PQ values /
Quality parameters vis-a –vis existing tender conditions to
amend in future tenders.

1 The dairies shall have a minimum of five years of
continues experience in dairy operations including
Cow ghee production.

2 The dairies shall have to furnish minimum handling of
cow milk per day throughout the year for the
production of ghee to enable to meet the requirement
of TTD.

i. In respect of National tenders - 4.0 lakh litre/day

ii. In respect of 1500 kms radius tenders - 2.0 lakh
litre/day

iii. In respect of A.P tenders - 1.0 lakh litre/day

3 The minimum quantity of Cow ghee production /
sales of a dairy per month shall be as follows:

i.National tenders - 360 Tons per month

ii.1500 kms radius tenders - 180 Tons per month

iii. A.P tenders - 90 Tons per month

4 The delivery of ghee to TTD from dairy shall be within
15 days from the date of manufacturing.

5 Detection of buffalo milk in cow milk shall be verified
as and when the rapid protocols are available.
85
